style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, white sunlit interior
character: glossy dark red leech, thick ribbed body, no legs, round spectacles, banker's collar, fills two thirds of frame
props: a steel press with two rolls, a chute from it into a huge wooden barrel, ДЕНЬГИ КРОВЬ ЭКОНОМИКИ painted on it in big cyrillic capitals on three lines, red rising inside; a steel chain from the press hooked to the back of his collar; two clerk mites on his back with a stamp and a ledger strip; a fat bear banker in a monocle and lace jabot cranking a handle on the press
prop_continuity: chain on the back of his collar until the rolls; dark red pales to grey as the barrel fills; flat as a ribbon and alive from 7.8
motion_rule: every window he surges down the hall at the lens, body undulating, mouth and front sucker free and never attached; new shot size every window, camera always moving
environment: flooded bank hall, water over white marble, huge sunlit windows

audio.delivery: flat tired male voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: VY-dal, kre-DEET, te-PER, DOL-zhen, po-SLED-ney, KAP-li, KRO-vi
audio.pacing: steady natural tempo, never hurried; nothing said after 7.05
audio.lip_sync: sucker opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: water sloshing, stamp thud, chain and rolls grinding, crank creaking

timeline.a: he lunges at a wad of banknotes at the lens, the chain on his collar yanks him back mid-bite
timeline.c: big close on his mouth and the wad, whip to the chain

timeline.a: he surges the whole length of the flooded hall at the lens, chain grinding behind him, clerk mites scattering off his back into the water
timeline.c: big close pulling out to a low tracking shot

timeline.a: the chain snaps taut and rips a sheet of spray off the water at the lens, the stamp mite hammering his back
timeline.c: big close on the taut chain, whip

timeline.line: что я теперь должен ему все
timeline.a: he drives on toward the windows and rears up at the lens, the ledger mite unrolling a strip down his flank
timeline.c: low 3/4 beside him into a tight frontal, push in

timeline.a: he rams into the water, spray at the lens, both mites swinging out still hooked, the bear at the far press cranking once
he heaves into the window light, his dark red draining to grey along his body
still surging at the lens, he lifts his grey head as the red in the barrel behind him climbs
timeline.c: big close low frontal, push in

timeline.a: the chain reels him tail first into the rolls, his face to the lens, mites leaping clear
timeline.c: tight low frontal on his face and the rolls, push in

timeline.a: he shoots out the near side a flat red ribbon no thicker than his collar, spectacles still on, and whips upright flapping like a flag
timeline.c: big close low, whip up with him

timeline.a: the flat ribbon of a leech slaps across the lens and rears back indignant, waving his flattened body, the bear in the monocle cranking behind him and the barrel slopping over
timeline.c: big close on the flat leech at the lens, the bear behind him

must_appear: the rolls flattening him into a ribbon; the flat leech alive at the lens through the whole final window, flapping; the bear cranking behind him; ДЕНЬГИ КРОВЬ ЭКОНОМИКИ readable on the barrel
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, any lettering other than ДЕНЬГИ КРОВЬ ЭКОНОМИКИ, static camera, a wide with him small in frame, he stands still while speaking, any hose or tube touching his head, anything in his mouth but banknotes, blood spraying out of his body, the leech limp lifeless or dying, a leech still thick after the rolls, the bear alone in the final window, English speech, any word after 7.05
